description_en: Jyo Bāhāḥ is located to the east of Patan Darbar Square and can be accessed via a passage that runs south from the Olakhu Square junction. Its three-storey god house faces north and is crowned by aphucāwith a tiled roof and a finial. The principal façade of the structure has a door at its centre; this is flanked by two small blind windows, statues of Maudgalyāyana and Sāriputra and two stone lions (established in VS 2022/1966 CE). A bell hangs to the left-hand side of the door.Clad in brass, the door is topped with atoraṇathat contains an image of Akṣobhya at its centre with Lokeśvara to his left and Prajñāpāramitā to his right. Normally, Prajñāpāramitā is found on the left-hand side and Lokeśvara on the right, however their position has here been reversed. The currenttoraṇais a replacement; the previous one was stolen in the 2000s. The stolen one is described inLocke(1985, 77) and dated back to NS 808 (1688 CE). The first floor of the god house is separated from the ground floor by a carved timber cornice and projectinglhāḥkā. Theāgamaon the first floor display a threefoldpāsukājhyaḥwith a central opening covered by a decorative metal screen on its main façade. Meanwhile, a central lattice window with two small operable windows on either side can be found on the second floor. The overhanging tiled roof is supported by carved struts containing carvings of Buddhist deities. Inside the sanctum of the god house, one can find a north-facing stone statue of Akṣobhya, two stone inscriptions, and the metal cloth of Dīpaṅkara Buddha. The metal cloth is used at the Ilhane Samyak festival.The main god house is attached to residential buildings on its eastern and southern sides. The courtyard is open to the west and provides access to other residential buildings. Thedigichẽof thebāhāḥstands in front of the monument's northern side. This is a one-storied building with a central five-bayed colonnaded structure. Two stone inscriptions are attached to the walls of thisdigichẽ. The eastern building of the courtyard collapsed completely with the 2015 earthquake.The brick-paved courtyard of thebāhāḥmeasures around 13 m x 13 m and contains a row of different types ofcaityasanddharmadhātumaṇḍala,all of which are lined up in front of the building. The courtyard can be accessed from the entry in the west, and also contains statues of Gaṇeśa, Hanumān, Mahākāla, Mañjuśrī on the sides of its open platforms. There is also a small passageway in the south-eastern corner of the courtyard.No inscription could be found that mentions the establishment of this Vihāra. However, according to theNepālikabhūpavaṃśāvalī(19.3.17)  this monastery was established during the reign of King Siddhinarasiṃha Malla. It is believed that brothers established Jyo Bāhāḥ, Vajrakīrti Mahāvihāra and Om Bāhāḥ. Tradition dictates that, after initiation (cūḍākarma), abaṭuka(an initiate) initiated in the Jyo Bāhāḥ must visit Akṣobhya of the Om Bāhāḥ, and an initiate of the Om Bāhāḥ must visit Akṣobhya of the Jyo Bāhāḥ.
description_ne: यो विहार आदर्श कन्या निकेतन स्कूलको पूर्वपट्टि अवस्थित छ । यस विहारलाई संस्कृतमा रुद्रदेवानंगपाल संस्कारित ज्योतिवर्ण महाविहार भनिन्छ । यो विहारको द्य:छेँ उत्तराभिमुख गरी तीन तलाको बनाइएको छ । द्य:छेँको सबभन्दा माथि झिँगटीको छाना राखी पुर बनाइएको छ । छानालाई थाम्न चारवटा कलात्मक टुँडालहरू राखिएका छन् । दोस्रो तलामा बीचमा एउटा र दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा गरी तीनवटा झ्यालहरू राखिएका छन् । विहारको पहिलो तलामा आगम रहेको छ । यस तलामा बीचमा एउटा त्रिखाझ्याल राखिएको छ । उक्त झ्यालको माथि पञ्चबुद्धको चित्र बनाइएको छ । पञ्चबुद्धको चित्रको पूर्वपट्टि हरिहरिहरिवाहन लोकेश्वर र पश्चिमपट्टि मायादेवीको चित्र बनाइएको छ । भुइँतलामा विहारको गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकालाई पित्तलको पाताले मोडिएको छ । ढोकामाथि काठको तोरण राखिएको छ । तोरणको मध्यभागमा अक्षोभ्य राखिएको छ । नियमानुसार अक्षोभ्यको दायाँतिर प्रज्ञापारमिता र बायाँतिर लोकेश्वर हुनुपर्नेमा यहाँको तोरणमा दायाँतिर लोकेश्वर र बायाँतिर प्रज्ञापारमिता राखिएको छ । केही वर्षअघि पुरानो तोरण चोरी भएपछि यो नयाँ तोरण राखिएको हो । गर्भगृहभित्र अक्षोभ्यको उत्तराभिमुख शिलामूर्ति छ । गर्भगृहभित्र दुईवटा शिलापत्र र इल्हने सम्यक्‌मा लगिने दीपङ्कर बुद्धको मूर्तिको धातुको आवरण सुरक्षित राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र प्रवेश गर्ने ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ सारिपुत्र र मौद्‌गल्यायनको मूर्ति पनि स्थापना गरिएको छ । प्रवेशद्वारको अगाडि एक जोडी सिंह पनि राखिएको छ । पुरानो सिंह जीर्ण भएपछि द्य:छेँको दायाँ-बायाँ विसं २०२२ सालमा नयाँ सिंह स्थापना गरिएको थियो । द्य:छेँको अगाडि पूर्वपट्टि घण्टा झुण्ड्याइएको छ ।यो विहार कहिले स्थापना गरियो भन्ने  बारे कुनै अभिलेख पाइँदैन ।नेपालिकभूपवंशावली(१९.३.१७)मा सिद्धिनरसिंह मल्लको पालामा यो विहार स्थापना गरिएको कुरा उल्लेख छ ।वज्रकीर्ति महाविहार, ओम् बाहा: (LAL7040) र ज्यो बाहा: निर्माण गर्ने व्यक्तिहरू दाजुभाइ हुन् भन्ने भनाइ छ । चूडाकर्मपछि ओमबाहा:मा चूडाकर्म गरेका बटुकलाई ज्योबाहा:को क्वा:पा:द्य: र ज्यो बाहा:मा  सो कर्म गरेकालाई ओम बाहा:को क्वा:पा:द्य:भित्र प्रवेश गराउनुपर्ने प्रावधानले यस तथ्यको पुष्टि गर्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The courtyard was paved withteliabricks by Avaladeva and Caṇḍikā.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a pair of lion statues
historical_events.event_description: A pair of lion statues were donated and installed in front of the sanctum.
Nepal's Department of Archaeology reconstructed thebāhāḥwith the support of the German government.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a brass lhegā (cloth) to kvāḥpāḥdyaḥ
historical_events.event_description: Prajāpati Thakura Lakṣmī and his wife Santalakṣmī donated a brasslhegā(outer garment made of metal) tokvāḥpāḥdyaḥ
A bell was donated by Pūnadhãju, Lāni Thakũ and others.

historical_events.event_name: Repair of the monastery and the digichẽ
historical_events.event_description: Daivajña Motirāja, Daivajña Durggārāja, Daivajña Caṇḍīrāja, Daivajña Rāmarāja, Daivajña Ciṣarāja and Daivajña Girirāja renovated thevihāraand thedigi. The floor of thedigichẽwas also added. At that time, thetharapāof thevihārawas Amaradeva.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a golden face to Akṣobhya
historical_events.event_description: Sūryarāja, Paru, Dharmmajoti, Bhairava and Hākurāja donated a golden face to Akṣobhya. It was agreed that if the golden face goes missing  the person responsible for performing the daily ritual worship must pay for its replacement. In this inscription, thebāhāḥis referred to as Jerabāhāra.
Kṛṣṇavīr Nāike, his wife Thakũmati, son Bekhārāja and daughter Siddhilakṣmī donated pillars and capital of a main pillar (methā̃) to hang the bell.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a pair of door panels
historical_events.event_description: Jujulāla donated a pair of door panels to be fixed to the entrance of the sanctum.
Keśavarāja and Viṣṇumāyā donated the oil-lamp balustrade.
The courtyard of thebāhāḥwas paved withteliabricks thanks to the help of the District Development Committee and local people.

historical_events.event_name: Reconstruction of digichẽ after the earthquakes of 2015
historical_events.event_description: Thedigichẽcollapsed in the 2015 earthquake. It was rebuilt with the financial support of Lalitpur Metropolitan City and local people.
